        return 1
    res = qpow(base, exp >> 1)
    res = (res * res) % MOD
    if exp & 1:
        res = (res * base) % MOD
    return res

           (b[p1][1] and b[p2][2] and b[p3][0]) or \
           (b[p1][2] and b[p2][0] and b[p3][1]) or \

    f[mask] = (f[mask] + prob) % MOD
